name: SongCabin
description: A single-page, BandCamp-inspired web app for uploading and playing music, built with React, Redux, and Ruby on Rails.

paragraphs: SongCabin is a single-page, BandCamp-inspired web app for uploading and playing music, built with React, Redux, and Ruby on Rails. It uses custom-designed controls to trigger methods on the HTML audio element and employs a global UI state to enable cross-component audio play. It integrates Amazon Web Services to seamlessly upload, store & deliver image and audio content, and also utilizes FormData objects and nested attributes to upload the data for an album and multiple tracks at once. The Search function uses an event listener to track user input and make a database call for matching Album…
